about: Custom types P4 residual round (N1, N2): boot cells (harness_type_gart2, map all) with waiting monster_art while the map mod harness_map_type (map harness_t) is deferred. A typo ('nwet') waits at boot with no error, and is the 'unknown monster' mod error after the deferred load of a harness_t save, when no deferred map mod is left. A waiting newt-only cell with an intermission gives no false 'no mon_spr' error at boot, and its replayed art gets the frame rules (its 5-frame loop_ej strip is reported). The travel boot loads harness_map_type before the cells, so both errors show there at once: that is the one dialog.
expect_mod_errors: Cell 'TYPE GART TYPO' monster_art: unknown monster 'nwet'
Cell 'TYPE GART FRAMES': strip 'a5' (monster_art.newt.loop_ej) has 5 frames, it needs 6 per row
